newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish Treasury sets the amount for Dec auctions.
newsitem.headline: Spanish Treasury sets the amount for Dec auctions.

text.p: The Bank of Spain announced on Monday the amount of notes and bonds the Spanish Treasury would tender at its monthly auctions on Tuesday and Wednesday.
Following are the minimum and maximum amounts:
ISSUE Expected amount Maximum amount Auction date
* This is the amount actually sold on the market and includes the second segment of the auction.

NOTE -- The Spanish Treasury is offering a new 10-year bond, with a lower coupon at 7.35 percent from the 8.80 percent of the previous issue. The new bond will be issued on December 16, 1996 and is due on March 31, 2007. The first coupon is due on 31 March 1998. Three-, five- and ten-year bonds are new tranches of old issues.
